notes.title: Language Issue in Chapter 12 and 13 Patch
notes.content:
Happy 2023! We’ve been excited to be part of several events this year including Steam Puzzle Fest, Steam Visual Novel Fest and Gradient Convergence presented by Game Devs of Color Expo! Hello to any new friends out there!

For the PC version, we’ve fixed a language issue in Chapter 12 and 13 regarding Big O Notation. Thanks to Vertani for pointing it out!

If anyone else notices something we should fix, you can always contact us at  https://prettysmartgames.com/contact or join our Discord: https://discord.gg/nrTTyjj

And thank you to those of you that have already mentioned things here on Steam, we appreciate you bringing them up even if we can’t fix them yet!

notes.content:
Added support for cloud saves syncing between Mac computers
 Minor fix to the settings menu

notes.title: Update notes for 2.3.0!
notes.content:
Happy 1 year anniversary! We updated the save system and made some improvements. Here's what's new:


 Cloud saves: your save slots will now migrate between computers!

 Save checkpoints: Your progress is now saved several times in longer chapters. Look for a save disk icon in the upper right corner!

 Added a disclaimer: just in case you weren't sure, this is a fictional story!

 Typos and animation bugs fixed!
